items.title: File Widerspruch against the Elterngeld decision
items.quote: Er ist binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Kreisverwaltung Beispiel-Eifel, Elterngeldstelle, Moselufer 31, 56812 Musterburg an der Mosel, einzulegen.
items.computation: The letter is a decision of a Land social-law authority (Elterngeldstelle) and itself states it applies § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X for delivery, not the AO Finanzamt rule. Posting day = letter date 04.02.2025 (Tuesday), no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is given. Bekanntgabefiktion: 4th day after posting = 08.02.2025 (Saturday). For non-tax authorities (incl. SGB X bodies) the delivery day does NOT move even if it falls on a weekend/holiday, so delivery is deemed on Sat 08.02.2025. One-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG / § 26 SGB X with §§ 187, 188 BGB): day of delivery not counted, period of one month runs from 08.02.2025 to the day in the next month with the same number, i.e. 08.03.2025. That date is a Saturday, so under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 193 BGB the deadline moves to the next working day: Monday 10.03.2025. No public holiday in Rheinland-Pfalz falls between 08.03. and 10.03.2025.

items.title: Start of reduced (offset) Elterngeld payments covering Lebensmonat 3
items.quote: Das Mutterschaftsgeld und den Arbeitgeberzuschuss haben wir für die ersten beiden Lebensmonate angerechnet; für diese Monate zahlen wir 0,00 €. Ab dem 3. Lebensmonat überweisen wir 1.147,12 € monatlich.
items.computation: The child Ida was born 19.11.2024, so Lebensmonat 1 runs 19.11.2024–18.12.2024 and Lebensmonat 2 runs 19.12.2024–18.01.2025, both offset with Mutterschaftsgeld (0,00 €). Lebensmonat 3, from which the monthly payment of 1.147,12 € begins, starts 19.01.2025. The letter does not state the exact bank transfer day each month, so no precise due_date can be fixed for the recurring payments.

items.title: End of the approved Elterngeld entitlement period
items.quote: also für die Zeit vom 19.11.2024 bis 18.11.2025.
items.computation: The letter states the approved benefit period explicitly as 19.11.2024 to 18.11.2025 (the child's 1st to 12th Lebensmonat); this end date is given directly in the letter and requires no further calculation.
